title: [review] provisioning.py:570: EDHOC failure in provisio
description: If process_message_1() or process_message_3() raises an exception (lines 571-574), the session created by create_br_session() at line 567 is never removed. Unlike the ACK failure path (line 599) which calls _remove_session(), EDHOC failures propagate without cleanup. The session lingers until session_lifetime expiry, holding cryptographic material and consuming a slot toward max_sessions.
